text:
Comprehensive Portfolio Management LLC grew its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 43.6% in the 3rd its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The firm owned 34,583 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 10,501 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for about 2.0% of Comprehensive Portfolio Management LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 12th biggest holding. Comprehensive Portfolio Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $7,807,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
Several other institutional investors also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the company. Delphi Private Advisors LLC bought a new stake in shares of Apple in the second quarter worth $120,000. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC bought a new stake in shares of Apple in the first quarter worth $133,000. CX Institutional bought a new stake in shares of Apple in the second quarter worth $135,000. Boston Standard Wealth Management LLC bought a new stake in shares of Apple in the third quarter worth $204,000. Finally, Diversified Investment Strategies LLC bought a new stake in shares of Apple in the second quarter worth $206,000. Institutional investors own 57.08% of the company’s stock.
